# omx fbs

The feedback corrector: finds the frequencies that ring in a mono signal and plants a notch on each, reporting each as a band.

- CLAP id: `urn:openmixer:fbs`
- LV2 URI: `urn:openmixer:fbs`
- Parameters: 103, plus the host's bypass

## Audio ports

| Direction | Name | Role | Channels |
|---|---|---|---|
| in | in | main | 1 (mono) |
| out | out | main | 1 (mono) |

## Pages

A page is where a host shows a parameter. In LV2 each page is a port group, `pg:group <urn:openmixer:fbs#<symbol>>`, whose `lv2:displayPriority` is the number below (a host that shows the higher first, as Zynthian does, shows the pages in port order). In CLAP each page is the module of its parameters (`clap_param_info.module`), the page labels joined by `/`.

| Page | LV2 group symbol | Priority | CLAP module | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Bypass

CLAP: the host's bypass, a parameter named Bypass at id 2147418112 (0x7FFF0000) in every plugin, flagged automatable, stepped and bypass; 0 is processing, 1 bypassed. The id never moves when a parameter is appended.
LV2: the port `enabled` (`lv2:designation lv2:enabled`) at index 0, 1 is processing, 0 is bypassed; the output port `latency` at index 1 reports the latency in frames. Both come before the audio and parameter ports in every plugin, so neither moves; a preset or a session names a port by its symbol.
